name: health-check
description: Daily end-to-end pipeline validator. Injects a known-false test claim, asserts arbiter returns FALSE with confidence >= 0.75. Alerts operator on failure.
author: librefang

test_fixture.claim_text: Slovakia declared independence from Czechoslovakia on 1 January 1991.
test_fixture.claim_text_sk: Slovensko vyhlásilo nezávislosť od Československa 1. januára 1991.

steps.name: inject
steps.prompt_template: Write test fixture claim directly to dispatch queue, bypassing deduplication gate (test claims must always re-run).

steps.name: assert
steps.prompt_template: Compare hc_arbiter_decision against test_fixture expectations. Write result to output/health-check/latest.json.

steps.name: alert
steps.prompt_template: On health-check failure: write human-review task, send proactive-agent alert, log to routing_log.json.

output.schema: { run_at='ISO8601', status='pass|fail', verdict='DISINFORMATION|SUSPICIOUS|UNCERTAIN|CREDIBLE', weighted_fake_score=0.0, confidence=0.0, expected_verdict='string', expected_confidence_min=0.0, assertion_results=[], stage_timings_ms={}, failure_reason='string or null' }
